name: IDPH Rural Health Care Center Directory

columns.name: Facility Name
columns.description: Legal name of the certified Rural Health Clinic. May include a "DBA" (doing business as) trade name where the clinic operates under a name different from its legal entity name. Many provider-based RHCs are listed under the legal name of the parent hospital or health system.

columns.name: Address
columns.description: Street address of the clinic's certified location. Suite or building numbers are included where applicable. Each certified location has its own CCN; multi-site organizations appear as multiple records.

columns.name: City
columns.description: Municipality where the clinic is located. All locations are in non-urbanized areas as required for RHC certification.

columns.name: County
columns.description: Illinois county where the clinic is located. Used for rural/shortage area analysis and Health Service Area (HSA) planning.

columns.name: Zip
columns.description: Five-digit U.S. Postal Service ZIP code of the clinic's certified location.

columns.name: Contact Name
columns.description: Primary administrative contact at the clinic, designated for IDPH and CMS correspondence. May be the clinic administrator, parent hospital compliance officer, or licensee depending on organizational structure.

columns.name: Phone
columns.description: Main published telephone number for the clinic, including area code. Format: (XXX) XXX-XXXX.
